abstract:
We propose a scheme for perfect transfer of an unknown qubit state via the discrete-time quantum walk on a line or a circle. For this purpose, we introduce an additional coin operator which is applied at the end of the walk. This operator does not depend on the state to be transferred. We show that perfect state transfer over an arbitrary distance can be achieved only if the walk is driven by an identity or a flip coin operator. Other biased coin operators and Hadamard coin allow perfect state transfer over finite distances only. Furthermore, we show that quantum walks ending with a perfect state transfer are periodic.

January 2015

specification.problem: Perfect transfer of an unknown qubit state via a discrete-time quantum walk on a line or circle, using an extra final coin operator independent of the state. Determine which coin operators permit perfect state transfer over arbitrary versus only finite distances, and show that walks ending in perfect state transfer are periodic.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Abstract-level reconstruction of the PST scheme: walk with coin C, shift, final extra coin operator; claims about identity/flip coins versus biased/Hadamard coins and periodicity. Detailed derivations, the final coin's explicit form, and the transfer-distance bounds are not in the abstract.

additional final coin operator, independent of the state

equations.label: Walk step
equations.description: One step of the discrete-time quantum walk: coin then conditional shift.
equations.justification: Standard definition of the discrete-time quantum walk.

equations.label: Perfect state transfer condition
equations.description: Final state has the qubit state at position d, with the final coin applied last, for all psi.
equations.abstract_quote: perfect transfer of an unknown qubit state
equations.justification: Formalizes the stated goal; the explicit form is an assumption of this reconstruction.
assumptions: The state is initially encoded in the coin at the origin
Target coin state equals psi (could differ by a fixed, state-independent unitary)

specification.initial_state: |0>_x ⊗ (alpha|0>+beta|1>)_coin, walker at origin with the unknown qubit in the coin

steps.description: Prepare walker at origin with the unknown qubit in the coin register.
Apply t steps of the walk U (coin C then conditional shift S).
Apply the additional final coin operator C_f to the coin register, independent of psi.
Check that the walker is at position d with coin state psi (perfect transfer).

specification.measurement: Not specified in the abstract. For verification, one could measure the position register to confirm location d and perform state tomography on the coin qubit to compare with psi.
specification.classical_postprocessing: None specified in the abstract. Verification only: compare the reconstructed coin state with psi via fidelity; check periodicity of the walk by repeating over t.
assumptions: Initial walker position is the origin with the qubit stored in the coin.
Register sizes and the measurement/verification procedure are assumed, not from the abstract.
Registers are position plus a single coin qubit.
